entries.anchor: ### Step 3c: Ship Mode — attached or detached
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#887/#874: sched only waits for a merge, so a detached park on an inert auto-merge label never merged (#878, #869, #871). Detached needs a confirmed mechanism, autoMergeRequest is read back (label is not proof; an already-merged PR reads null too), else fall back to attached with an allowed merge method; ship_mode/merge_mechanism/ship_evidence are on the ship runstate and ship_mode=attached keeps sched from parking a run that is still merging.
